title: Desktop identity bootstrap v2
$comment: Core/C# v2 implemented and locally tested; not a desktop release claim. Core additionally rejects equal tokens, duplicate JSON keys and linked/protected worker paths before opening the database. JSON Schema alone is insufficient.

openmaic_node_worker.$comment: Optional trusted launch configuration only. The Core requires absolute local non-linked paths, rejects E/F and UNC paths, checks the executable name and its declared SHA-256, and pins the OpenMAIC 1.3.0 worker and generation 0.3.28 file hashes. A digest is an identity check, not Node version qualification. Missing files or mismatched bytes leave ordinary Core operations available. A malformed launch document remains invalid. HTTP requests cannot select these paths.

root.$comment: One directory the other paths may be written relative to. Absolute paths keep working; a relative path with no root is refused by the Core rather than guessed.

routes.$comment: Additional capability routes. The default `script` serves text.extract; each entry registers one more capability against the worker that implements it, so a PDF or OCR job reaches its own engine instead of failing with no registered worker. Declared, never guessed from a checkout layout. An absent list keeps the single-route behaviour.
